newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS SIGN NBA VETERAN SCOTT.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS SIGN NBA VETERAN SCOTT.

text.p: Former European basketball champions Panathinaikos signed NBA veteran Byron Scott on Thursday in an effort to restore the club's fortunes.
Panathinaikos officials said they paid $1.5 million for the 1.93-metre guard who last played for Vancouver Grizzlies.
Scott, 36, won three NBA titles with the Los Angeles Lakers in 1985, 1987 and 1988 and has played more than 1,200 NBA matches.
